import html # Pre‑defined HTML template with placeholders INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {event_title} - Invitation
{event_title}
Date: {event_date}
{event_description}
{additional_notes}
""" def build_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, details_of_event: str, when_event_is: str, extra_event_info: str ) -> str: """ Construct a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters: title_of_event (str): The name or heading of the event. details_of_event (str): An extensive description of the event (may include multiple lines and formatting). when_event_is (str): The date on which the event is scheduled. extra_event_info (str): Any extra information or instructions supplied by the user. Returns: str: A sanitized HTML string that safely renders the invitation. """ # Escape all user supplied content to prevent XSS or injection escaped_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) escaped_description = html.escape(details_of_event, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') escaped_date = html.escape(when_event_is, quote=True) escaped_notes = html.escape(extra_event_info, quote=True).replace('\n', '
') # Format the template with sanitized values invitation_html = INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=escaped_title, event_date=escaped_date, event_description=escaped_description, additional_notes=escaped_notes ) return invitation_html
